notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
This small update fixes the rare issue with "stranger girl.png" not loading, caused by saving and loading at specific circumstances.
The code responsible for characters and events definitions has been slightly changed to accommodate this possibility.

It might work from where you are, but I recommend starting a new game just to make sure (just use the skip function).
Potential issues that might appear by continuing - Katie will always stay as "Strange Girl" or you will know her name before she introduces herself. I guess. There shouldn't be errors in character display or events connected to her.

Please let me know if you encounter other (or new, but I hope not...) issues.

~artoonu

notes.title: Visit the countryside!
notes.notes:
I'm happy to announce that the game is now available!
This time, different theme and something slightly different with event system, let me know what you think! I also tried something with presentation, transitions and... sound effects.

I hope you'll have as much fun playing, as I had making it :)
Use of AI image generation tools allows me to make much more interesting scenes and setting I wouldn't be able otherwise.

As always, special promotion for owners of my previous games or those who want to catch up!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25882/games_by_artoonu/

notes.title: Release date announcement!
notes.notes: Just a short note that the game will be released very soon, on 14 April 2023, Friday! Mark your calendars and get ready for departure to the countryside!
